name: talkif
description: Talkif for Claude Code: the Talkif API as tools, your sessions reachable by voice through the Talkif app, tasks between sessions, and calls that ring you when a session needs you.

apiKey.title: Talkif API key
apiKey.description: From the Talkif dashboard (Developer → Credentials). Permissions: Full access plus Connectors (or Read on flows plus Connectors); Read on calls for transcripts of calls to teammates; plus those of the Talkif tools you want Claude to use. Full access does not include Connectors. Stored in your keychain, never in settings.json.

apiUrl.title: API URL (advanced)
apiUrl.description: Leave empty for Talkif (https://api.talkif.ai). Only change it if Talkif support tells you to.

flowId.title: Flow
flowId.description: The id of the flow your calls run on. Empty: the first published flow with a Connectors node (/talkif setup shows which).

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Only sessions in these folders join (comma-separated, ~/ allowed). Empty: every session; /talkif on|off still decide.

debug.title: Debug traffic pane
debug.description: Record this session's Talkif traffic and show it with /talkif traffic.

parallel.title: Queue tasks while busy
parallel.description: Accept more tasks from a call while one runs (they queue) instead of declining.

callback.title: Ring back when a call task ends
callback.description: When a task given on a call finishes or gets stuck after the call ended, ring you with the result.

ringAfter.title: Ring me when a session waits (minutes)
ringAfter.description: never (default): a session rings you only while you are set away (/talkif away, or say it on a call), after one minute. 5, 10 or 30: also when you are not set away, once a session has waited that long for you. One ring per situation, never repeated.

ringOnQuestion.title: Ring for an open question
ringOnQuestion.description: A session stopped with a question or decision only you can answer.

ringOnPermission.title: Ring for a permission prompt
ringOnPermission.description: A session waits at a permission prompt. The call says in plain words what it wants to do and why, never the command itself; it can only be allowed at your computer.

ringOnFinish.title: Ring when a long task is done
ringOnFinish.description: A turn of 10 minutes or more finished.

callTasks.title: Tasks from calls
callTasks.description: read-only: while a task given on a call runs, tools that change anything are refused and the session reports what it would change. session: the session's own Claude Code permissions apply. The plugin never grants a permission in either mode.

sharing.title: Colleagues in your organization
sharing.description: In a Talkif organization, what people with the member role may do with your sessions on their calls. private: nothing. ask: ask questions, answered read-only. work: ask and give tasks. Owners and admins always reach your sessions fully; agents (call staff) never. Change one session with /talkif share.
